secondCauseNotReproduced.measured: Did NOT reproduce on this build. The tabs row measured 45px clear of the dock's top edge, and each session row walked into measured 0px covered.
secondCauseNotReproduced.likelyExplanation: The row never took focus before, so the existing dock-clearance focus listener (useDockClearanceOnFocus) never ran for it. Now that DOWN lands on it, the existing lift handles it. No layout change was needed.
